audit.whatIsWrong: The page contradicts itself on difficulty: diff reads FAV while tone is the red #ff5d6c, diffRating says 8.5/10 and report[14] calls it a 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: With rows 3-6 going to Nautilus and a 57.14% win rate over 35 Emerald+ games, the lane is favoured after level 3 — the prose says so too ('the lane tilts to you', 'You stay favored into his first item'). An 8.5/10 rating alongside diff FAV is a straight internal contradiction the reader sees on one screen. The mirror audit flagged the same mismatch on its side and left it for a deliberate call.
audit.corrected: tone to #3ddc97, diffRating to 5.5/10, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t restated to match. carryRating stays 8.5/10 — Lucian genuinely carries if he gets ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 5 named Lucian or Skill in both layers while the whys on those rows describe Nautilus winning each one.
audit.why: whys[3] 'Q-pull into passive root flips the trade'; whys[4] 'Depth Charge is a homing, undodgeable knockup that ignores his E — all-in ... for the kill'; whys[5] 'Your tank stats and CC chain still beat his first-item burst'. The packet chart reads Skill/Lucian/Lucian/Nautilus/Nautilus/Nautilus/Nautilus and the mirror audit flipped exactly rows 3-5 to Nautilus.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 5 flipped to Nautilus as matched full+content pairs, ratings raised to 6/10, 7/10 and 6/10, and the four late why strings rewritten with Relentless Pursuit's real 16s rank-1 cooldown. Row 0 left on Lucian: the packet says Skill, but whys[0] says his Lightslinger double-shot wins the raw level-1 trade and the mirror did not flip it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the interaction that most changes how Nautilus plays this lane: Lightslinger arms two bonus-damage autos whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilised, so Nautilus's own CC feeds Lucian's damage. Relentless Pursuit is also described only as 'his dash + reset' with no cooldown and no mention that his attacks shorten it.
audit.why: enemyKit P: 'When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.' enemyKit E: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown' — so the dash timer is not a fixed window you can count down, it shrinks as he attacks.
audit.corrected: The immobilise-arms-his-passive interaction written into dontsFull[1].d; Relentless Pursuit's 16s rank-1 cooldown and its attack-driven reduction stated in dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.
sources: enemyKit P and E text and cooldowns

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Relentless Pursuit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane tilts to you: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 — bait the dash, then Dredge Line pulls an escape-less Lucian into your root.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — the all-in always starts. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lucian's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Depth Charge homes and cannot be dashed out of — all-in the moment Relentless Pursuit is spent and chain the knockup into root and Riptide slow.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet plus tank stats still eat his first-item burst — force fights while his E is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Lucian carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: engage from fog so he cannot dash your anchor — open with Depth Charge, not Q, and the lockup outlasts his kite.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1; his autos shorten it. Bait it first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Your CC arms him: immobilising anyone gives two bonus-damage autos.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Hook + passive root chain.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and his Lightslinger attacks cut it — every ability he casts means a double-shot next.

notes: The missingInteractions file flags needs-antiheal for Lucian, and the kit's derived 'heal' flag sits on Lightslinger — but Riot's text says only that Lucian gains bonus damage when he IS healed or shielded BY AN ALLY. Nothing in his kit heals him. That is a tooltip-parsing misfire and I deliberately did NOT add any Grievous Wounds advice; buying anti-heal into a solo-lane Lucian would waste a slot. Content spikes[1] and mid call Nautilus's W 'Titan's Wrath' and E 'Riptide' — those are Renekton's and Tahm Kench's names respectively, not Nautilus's, but the same naming runs through several nautilus pages, so it looks like a repo-wide convention rather than a one-page slip. Flagging rather than editing: if it is an error it needs a champion-wide sweep, not one matchup.
